methodologyNotes: Covers rechargeable bicycle safety lights (headlights and taillights) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes dynamo/hub-powered lights, non-rechargeable coin-cell blinkers, and lights integrated into an e-bike's system. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. lightType is one of front (white headlight), rear (red taillight), or both. maxLumens is peak rated output in lumens on the brightest mode. runtimeHighHrs is the manufacturer-rated runtime in hours on the highest STEADY (non-flashing) setting; runtimeLowHrs is rated runtime in hours on the lowest steady setting (longest steady burn). batteryCapacityMah is internal battery capacity in mAh; null if not disclosed. chargePort is the charging connector: usb-c, micro-usb, or proprietary. chargeTimeHrs is rated time to a full charge in hours; null if not disclosed. weightGrams is claimed weight in grams including the primary mount. waterResistanceRating is the ingress-protection code as published (e.g. IPX4, IPX6, IPX7). mountType is the primary included mount: handlebar, seatpost, helmet, or clip. modeCount is the number of selectable light modes (steady plus flash/pulse patterns).
